Redline round 2

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 1 (57f7c19..f65baa7).

The round 1 fixes do what their findings asked, and each one is pinned in tests/loop-test.mjs. A review with no carry-forward list now clears a copied carriedFrom with a warning. The fallback carry is numbered after the highest id in use. An earlier thread whose carrying finding sits in the review body is swept on its own reply. The handoff names an earlier run's carry by its new id. The R1-2 decision is applied as decided: a known mark that names a Redline finding is cleared, so the finding is carried. A carried finding that an issue tracks stays under Already tracked with its origin suffix, and its earlier thread is answered once, from both the revise pass and the standalone path. That reply ("carried forward as R2-1; ...") is exactly what redline-gh.sh prior-findings reads back as carried, and the suffixed Already tracked line is never read as a finding line. I traced these paths (review dial, correctness scope, review-only, final nit pass, sweep and handoff) and found no new correctness bug. I read the tests rather than ran them, because node is not available to the reviewer role.

No findings.
